name: age-of-empires-iv-turns-5
note: في مثل هذا اليوم: Age of Empires IV released 28 Oct 2021 on PC (Steam app 1466860 release date); Xbox 22 Aug 2023, PS5 4 Nov 2025; Raiders of the North expansion 29 Oct 2026 on Steam (app 4336170, 74 AED UAE). Footage: Xbox Game Showcase trailer (June 2021) cinematic shots that fit 9:16, and the Raiders announce trailer key art and a snow village. Both trailers are narrated throughout (speechcheck), so our everyday bed, as for on-this-day pieces; the Raiders narration names Valhalla, another reason not to use it.
lines:
صدرت يوم 28 أكتوبر 2021
من استوديو ريليك (Relic)

ووصلت لاحقًا إلى Xbox
ثم PS5 العام الماضي

وتصل غدًا إضافة جديدة
بحضارتين جديدتين
